English.Char_Desc_2000:
Book Reader reads EPUB, Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3, PRC), PDF, plain text and saved web pages. The first time, it finds the books in Documents\My Kindle Content; Add books and Add folder add more. The library shows every book's cover, title, author, how far you have read and its genre; sort, search, and keep favorites and collections. Continue reading opens the book you read last, where you left off. While reading: turn pages, open the contents, search, bookmark, highlight, add notes, change the text size and page color, and have the book read aloud with Windows' voices. Save a copy as EPUB, PDF, plain text or Word. Free books lists websites that give classics away. Locked books are listed with the reason; nothing here removes copy protection.
Before you install: Microsoft Word is optional: it is only used to save a copy of a book as a Word document. Reading, the library and every other kind of copy work without it. Setup tells you if Word is not found. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Book Reader is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Book Reader is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
